numericConvention: Numbers transcribed as printed in Table 1; percent-style values, not fractional AbsRel.
result: Lower metric AbsRel on all three reported datasets

protocol.en: Single-model zero-shot full-ERP evaluation under the paper DA2 panorama protocol. Six 518x518 faces are reprojected to 512x1024 ERP; metric depth is evaluated without GT scale/shift alignment.
protocol.zh: 论文采用单模型零样本完整 ERP 评测，沿用 DA² 全景协议；六个 518×518 面重投影为 512×1024 ERP，米制深度不使用真值尺度/偏移对齐。

limitations.en: All three quantitative panorama datasets are indoor. This is an author-reported benchmark comparison, not proof of superiority on outdoor/robotic trajectories or temporal consistency. Released default config evaluates aligned modes; enable metric_depth_eval for raw metric evaluation.
limitations.zh: 三个全景定量基准均为室内。属于作者报告，不能推出室外、机器人轨迹或时间一致性全面优于 DAP。公开默认配置评测对齐模式；原始米制评测须启用 metric_depth_eval。
